description: The tallest thing in Halcyon Fields that is not the Spire, nineteen floors of shearing glass on a chrome podium, with a lit collar at every fifth level. It was named before the streets round it were laid, which means it has spent four years being the prime location in a field. The entrance is a double-height slot in the chrome podium on the Cinder Lane side, with the name cut into the stone above it in letters a foot high and a lit collar directly overhead that makes the doorway the brightest thing on the lane.
